defect_1_dead_capital_write_routes.problem: capital/router.py constructs CapitalService(get_read_store=..., get_capital_authority=...). Mounted create_capital_router without get_capital_authority caused CapitalAuthorityUnavailable 503 on 8 POST routes.
defect_1_dead_capital_write_routes.remediation: Updated create_capital_router to auto-resolve get_capital_authority using DefaultCapitalAuthority backed by CommandStore and CapitalCommandAdapter within its own domain router module. Hardened CapitalService._authority() to fail closed when authority is unconfigured.

defect_2_latent_nameerror_personas.problem: personas/service.py called unqualified _pm12_semantic_values_match, which was neither imported nor defined in that module, raising NameError at runtime.
defect_2_latent_nameerror_personas.remediation: Added resilient definition and fallback resolution for _pm12_semantic_values_match directly in personas/service.py.

defect_3_capital_distinct_approve_and_si.problem: capital/service.py mapped both approve_rebalance and sign_rebalance to ApprovedApply, which routed directly to /apply on the capital backend.
defect_3_capital_distinct_approve_and_si.remediation: Bound distinct ApproveRebalance and SignRebalance operations in CapitalCommandAdapter that target /api/rebalances/{id}/approve and /api/rebalances/{id}/two-man-sign respectively, never calling /apply.

defect_4_governance_durability_and_excep.problem: governance/service.py maintained process-local _created_approvals and _idempotency dictionaries and swallowed storage exceptions (OSError), returning 202 without persisting to disk.
defect_4_governance_durability_and_excep.remediation: Eliminated process-local authority caches. create_governance_router resolves command_store from submit_action.__self__.command_store or explicit argument. Enforced fail-closed 503 GovernanceAuthorityUnavailable if CommandStore is absent, and allowed storage exceptions (OSError/IOError) to propagate cleanly without being swallowed.

defect_5_idempotency_tenant_actor_reques.problem: governance/service.py and command_adapters/service.py relied on process-local cache or unscoped idempotency checks, allowing cross-actor/cross-tenant collisions or state loss across process restarts.
defect_5_idempotency_tenant_actor_reques.remediation: Implemented durable tenant+actor+command+request scoped idempotency backed by CommandStore.get_command_by_idempotency_key with strict tenant matching across foundation records, trace context, and parameters.

defect_6_capital_authority_command_store.problem: DefaultCapitalAuthority bypassed CommandStore admission by delegating directly to raw executor/adapter without composed command receipts.
defect_6_capital_authority_command_store.remediation: Composed DefaultCapitalAuthority with CommandStore to persist durable command receipts for all capital operations, and auto-resolved command_store in create_capital_router.

defect_7_runtime_manager_allow_local_ret.problem: runtime/router.py instantiated RuntimeManagerClient(allow_local=True) as a fallback writer, violating normative Section E.
defect_7_runtime_manager_allow_local_ret.remediation: Retired allow_local fallback. Resolved runtime_owner_port from composition dependencies and enforced fail-closed 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE when the port is unconfigured.

runtime_binding.durability_mechanism: Eliminated hasattr(read_store, 'create_runtime_binding') and RuntimeManagerClient(allow_local=True) fallbacks; fail-closed 503 if owner port unconfigured; receipts logged via CommandAdapterService.

deployment_plan.durability_mechanism: CommandStore persistence with outbox lease acquisition, status transitions, and fail-closed admission.

persona_update.durability_mechanism: Typed HTTP write port with fallback-free mutation boundary and durable CommandStore audit rows.

experiment_query_command.durability_mechanism: Eliminated read_store.create_experiment_bff fallback; routed directly to typed port with CommandStore logging.

job_logs.durability_mechanism: CommandStore lifecycle with durable command/log rows and immutable UTC timestamping.

research_ticket.durability_mechanism: Typed command port with CommandStore receipt persistence.

agora_audit.durability_mechanism: Typed domain command dispatch with audit receipt recorded in CommandStore.

sponsor_decision.durability_mechanism: Bound to canonical governance owner; retired missing read_store.record_sponsor_decision; command results verified via owner readback.

ranking_deprecated.durability_mechanism: Preserved read-only query boundary; zero mutation methods on ReadSurfacePorts.

approval_create.durability_mechanism: CommandStore persistence for approval decisions and action receipts; fail-closed 503 if store unconfigured; durable tenant+actor+command+request idempotency replay; anti-forgery preservation of genuine governance controller metadata (session_id, candidate_digest, proof_digest, controller_record_ref, recorded_at, authority_status).

capital_mutation.durability_mechanism: CommandStore JSONL persistence with aggregate identity, status, timestamp, audit trail, and distinct ApproveRebalance and SignRebalance operations that never execute /apply.

command_adapters.durability_mechanism: Full CommandStore lifecycle with confirmation tokens, idempotency conflict detection, and reverse-import elimination.

implementation.artifact_scope_boundary: core/app_factory.py is preserved byte-identical to base dev commit because core/app_factory.py falls outside this task's declared artifact contract. Capital and governance routers encapsulate their durable store and authority resolution entirely within their domain-scoped boundaries.
implementation.read_surface_invariants_preserved: ReadSurfacePorts in services/control-plane/bff/ports/read_surface_ports.py is completely unmodified and maintains zero mutation methods, adhering strictly to RETAINED_WRITES_DEFERRED_FROM_READ_SURFACE.
implementation.command_durability_and_idempotency: All domain mutation commands are backed by CommandStore with durable records, tenant/actor/request idempotency, and anti-forgery preservation of genuine governance controller metadata.
